name: Smartphone
preparation: Factory reset, remove SIM card and memory card
dataSafety: NIST 800-88 data wipe available on request

name: Laptop
preparation: Back up data, perform factory reset or full disk wipe
recyclingMethod: Shredding and material separation at WEEE facility
examples: MacBook, Dell XPS, Lenovo ThinkPad, HP Pavilion

name: Tablet
preparation: Factory reset, remove SIM, back up any data
recyclingMethod: Urban mining — indium tin oxide recovery
examples: iPad, Samsung Tab, Lenovo Tab, Amazon Fire

name: Keyboard
recyclingMethod: Disassembly — copper recovery and plastic recycling
examples: Mechanical keyboards, membrane keyboards, wireless keyboards

name: Mouse
recyclingMethod: Disassembly — PCB and plastic material recovery
examples: Wired mice, wireless mice, gaming mice, trackpads

name: Headphones
recyclingMethod: Magnet and copper recovery, plastic recycling
examples: Over-ear headphones, earphones, earbuds, gaming headsets

name: Charger & Adapter
examples: Phone chargers, laptop adapters, USB-C chargers, wireless charging pads

name: USB Cable
recyclingMethod: Copper wiring extraction and plastic recycling
examples: USB-A, USB-C, Lightning, micro-USB, HDMI cables

name: Rechargeable Battery
preparation: Do not puncture or crush; tape terminals with electrical tape
examples: AA/AAA rechargeable batteries, power banks, laptop batteries, phone batteries

name: Desktop Monitor
preparation: Handle with care — screens are fragile; do not break the panel
recyclingMethod: Mercury lamp removal, glass and metal recovery at specialist facility
examples: LCD monitors, LED monitors, ultrawide displays, CRT monitors

name: Printer
preparation: Remove ink cartridges (collect separately), remove paper
dataSafety: Clear print queue and network settings if applicable
recyclingMethod: Component disassembly and material stream separation
examples: Inkjet printers, laser printers, all-in-one printers, label printers

name: Smart Speaker
preparation: Factory reset and deregister from your account
dataSafety: Factory reset required — removes stored voice profiles
examples: Amazon Echo, Google Nest, Apple HomePod, Sonos
